# znap (`SMC17/znap`)

> Zero-allocation neural inference in Zig 0.16: RL policies in ~32 ns, llama2.c text generation at ~700 tok/s (M2 Max), no dependencies.

## Repository & Docs
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SMC17/znap
- [README](https://github.com/SMC17/znap/blob/main/README.md)
- [Build](https://github.com/SMC17/znap/blob/main/build.zig)
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/SMC17/znap/tree/main/benchmarks) & [Examples](https://github.com/SMC17/znap/tree/main/examples)
- [Source](https://github.com/SMC17/znap/tree/main/src)
